visual_integrity.rule: Every tactical shot must preserve both the local relation and enough formation structure to understand where it belongs.
visual_integrity.minimum_context: carrier + next option + nearest defender + two structural anchors
visual_integrity.edge_safe_rule: No tactical subject should sit on or be clipped by the portrait-frame edge.
visual_integrity.background_rule: Wide tactical views may reveal more board, but must never reveal a hard visual void beyond the pitch.
visual_integrity.field_scope_rule: The amount of pitch visible must be chosen by tactical information need, not by a fixed camera aesthetic.

camera_continuity.principle: preserve spatial continuity, but allow deliberate tactical scale changes between structure and relation shots

action_continuity.principle: the next tactical action begins in body orientation before the current action fully ends

defensive_response.principle: space must be created by visible collective defensive movement, not by static empty zones

scale_script.principle: CENTRAL_MASTER provides the spatial map; STRUCTURE and RELATION shots then use only the pitch extent needed to explain the current tactical question
rules: use full or near-full pitch only when the viewer needs global structure
use half-pitch or zone framing when the tactical relation is local
never show the whole field just to look complete
never crop pitch landmarks that are needed to understand the action
return to wider pitch context after a local tactical explanation when the next phase depends on global spacing
global-to-local and local-to-global scale changes may be decisive when the tactical question changes

BUILD.purpose: show LCB-Pirlo-first pressure and enough midfield landmark context without shrinking players

STRETCH.purpose: show both side midfielders stretching the block while keeping the midfield relation readable on mobile

BETWEEN_LINES.purpose: show Pirlo-Kaka-defender relation without wasting screen on remote pitch

OVERLAP.purpose: show Kaka-RB-defender triangle and overlap timing

SHIFT_AND_SWITCH.purpose: return to the floating spatial map before the weak-side switch so the defensive block movement is visible

COMPLETE.purpose: show weak-side receive, central occupation, defenders and goal relation

OPENING_MASTER.purpose: establish the floating pitch as the spatial map before any local explanation

field_scale_script.principle: field visibility and camera scale are chosen by tactical information needs, not visual uniformity

stages.purpose: locate first build-up relation and attack direction
show midfield width and defensive block stretch
show receiver between lines without losing reference structure
show strong-side attraction and weak-side release
show weak-side reception, depth, defenders and goal

central_master.principle: use a lower oblique floating-pitch master so the near end reads larger and the far end compresses, matching Teactics spatial depth while retaining the whole board
rules: pitch board centre owns composition in CENTRAL_MASTER
show the full physical board silhouette, not only the white touchlines
preserve dark breathing room around the board so it reads as suspended in space
do not let player clusters drag the master shot off-centre
use the floating master briefly as spatial orientation, then return to tactical relation framing

camera_anticipation.principle: prepare early, then hold steady through the tactical information
rules: camera should finish most of its move before the critical receive
global view is brief and exists only to explain the block shift
do not add a camera move for a detail that does not change tactical understanding

tactical_script_detail.thesis: Kaka attracts central pressure, the overlap overloads the right, the block shifts in sequence, then Seedorf receives on the weak side

phases.name: PIRLO_PREPARES
phases.attacker_detail: side midfielders widen before Kaka enters the next line
phases.defender_reaction: first striker closes, then the midfield line stretches
phases.spatial_change: a vertical lane appears between midfield and defence
phases.camera_intent: show only enough structure to understand why the lane opens

phases.name: KAKA_BETWEEN_LINES
phases.attacker_detail: Kaka accelerates into the right half-space instead of moving at the same time as the side midfielders
phases.defender_reaction: OM_C narrows first, OCB_R steps later
phases.spatial_change: central pressure increases and the outside lane becomes available
phases.camera_intent: camera is already local before Kaka receives

phases.name: RIGHT_OVERLAP
phases.trigger: Kaka receives facing forward and central pressure has committed
phases.defender_reaction: OM_R tracks wide while the centre-back remains occupied inside
phases.spatial_change: the right becomes the clear strong side
phases.camera_intent: move to the outside lane before RB's decisive acceleration

phases.name: BLOCK_SHIFT
phases.trigger: RB receives with the right side overloaded
phases.attacker_detail: Inzaghi pins the centre while Seedorf waits away from the block before advancing
phases.defender_reaction: OM_C shifts, then OCB_R, then OCB_L follows
phases.spatial_change: the block travels right and the left receiving pocket grows
phases.camera_intent: widen briefly to show the whole cause before the switch

phases.name: WEAK_SIDE_EXECUTION
phases.trigger: the weak-side pocket is now visible
phases.attacker_detail: RB opens his body and switches; Seedorf receives and attacks the exposed gap
phases.defender_reaction: OCB_L reacts late from a stretched position
phases.spatial_change: the weak-side pocket becomes a direct route toward goal
phases.camera_intent: hold the switch through first control, bridge through the attacking-third structure, then enter the finishing relationship without a hard scale jump

detail_filter.goal: keep only details that materially improve tactical causality, spatial reading, or camera anticipation
A_must_animate: weak-side receiver staying free until the block has shifted
camera arriving before the decisive receive
B_keep_selectively: one meaningful body-orientation cue before the weak-side switch
supporting width movements that explain the passing lane
C_remove_from_animation: duplicate body turns already implied by pass or run mechanics
extra late recovery movements that do not change the tactical explanation
micro-actions that lengthen the phase without changing the viewer's understanding

camera_exit.rule: Do not add tactical actions; preserve the TEST 03 visual system and finish by camera continuity only.

camera_pass_hold.rule: Do not leave the full lateral passing corridor before the receiver has controlled the ball.

scale_bridge.rule: After a long cross-field pass, preserve the master until first control, then step through an attacking-third structure shot before entering the local finishing relationship.

exit_bridge.rule: Exit local tactical detail in two scales: local result -> attacking-third structure -> floating central master. Never snap directly from local to full-board.

rules: pure black negative space
pitch only slightly brighter than background
thin neutral-grey field lines
flat clean yellow own-team silhouettes
muted neutral-grey opponents
no visible specular sheen
no decorative lighting
no heavy cast shadows
visual hierarchy must read tactics before materials
clean_core.rule_added: Preserve near-black pitch values without AgX lifting dark tones.
clean_core.root_fix: Convert authored HEX sRGB palette values to Blender linear material values before rendering.
clean_core.expected_result: near-black pitch remains near-black on output while yellow/grey preserve intended display colors

test10_camera_goal.target: less top-down; stronger near-to-far pitch perspective without becoming broadcast-low

test101_closer_read.rule: Keep the TEST 10 oblique perspective. Increase player readability by modestly tightening framing, not by turning the camera top-down again.

test1011_clean_floor.fix: make pitch bands identical to the base pitch so the surface reads as one clean near-black plane
